display.name: Conservative Income
display.description:
Capital-preservation mandate. The manager posts a first-loss buffer roughly 3x total depositor principal, so depositor capital sits behind a deep cushion before any drawdown reaches it. Exposure is limited to short-duration basis and funding capture on the deepest markets; no directional risk is carried overnight.

Exit threshold is set high (1.95x): depositors can force an orderly exit while the vault is still solvent rather than waiting for it to go underwater. Withdrawal limits are generous. Target yield is deliberately modest - this is the floor of the risk stack, not the ceiling.
